0: P.O Box 21, Clarkesville, GA 30523 (706) 754-4216 City of Clarkesville Brush Pickup Guidelines • All leaves and grass clippings must be paper bagged. • Limbs must be no larger than 4” in diameter and no longer than approximately 4’ – 6’ in length. Do not add stumps and vines to piles. • All brush piles should be placed within the right of way adjacent to the road for pickup. • Trees and limbs from lot clearing will be removed by the contractor. • Trees or brush piles generated by a contractor must be removed by the contractor. • Brush piles larger than 8’x4’x4’ will not be picked up. No more than 15 minutes will be allowed per pickup time. Brush removal is offered as a courtesy and is not performed on a regular schedule. If you have a pile that needs to be removed, please contact City Hall.
